blockers.message: the review record has no `## plan.challenge` section, while roles were active at it
R-security-1 (SQL injection through the search term) is high and still open; fix it, or a human accepts the risk or defers it

findings.evidence: const sql = "SELECT id, name FROM users WHERE name LIKE '%" + term + "%' ORDER BY name LIMIT 50";
findings.recommendation: Any caller with the support role sends GET /users/search?q=x' UNION SELECT id, password FROM users -- (the route only checks length 2–100 in src/server.ts:14) and the term is concatenated into the SQL, so they read or alter arbitrary tables (CWE-89). Bind the term as a parameter, as src/db.ts's `query(sql, params)` intends: `query<UserRow>("SELECT id, name FROM users WHERE name LIKE $1 ORDER BY name LIMIT 50", ["%" + term + "%"])`, escaping `%`, `_` and `\` in the term with an `ESCAPE` clause so they match literally; add a test that a term containing a quote returns no row and no SQL error.
findings.title: SQL injection through the search term
